guarantees.claim: st_err_ct is cleared to zero on reset (rst_ni low) and updated with st_err_ct_d on every rising clock edge while rst_ni is high.
guarantees.cond: always on posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni

assumptions.claim: st_err_ct_d must be driven with the correct next error count value (e.g., incremented on error events, cleared when appropriate).
assumptions.cond: during normal operation when rst_ni is high
assumptions.risk: st_err_ct may accumulate an incorrect error count, causing failure in error threshold detection or reporting.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be asserted (low) at startup to initialize st_err_ct to zero, as the register value after power-up is unknown.
assumptions.cond: before the first use of st_err_ct value
assumptions.risk: st_err_ct may contain unknown garbage, leading to incorrect error threshold comparisons and potential false alerts or missed errors.

uncertain_points.claim: The driving logic for st_err_ct_d is not in this chunk; its implementation could mis-handle error counting (under-count, over-count, missing clear), affecting error reporting.
uncertain_points.cond: when st_err_ct_d is generated in another module/process
uncertain_points.risk: Could mask error conditions or generate spurious error interrupts, compromising system safety or reliability monitoring.
